info.title: PROSPECTIVE Web API
info.description:
REST + WebSocket API for cerebral aneurysm segmentation, detection, morphometry, perforator risk assessment and stent planning.

All linear dimensions are in **millimetres (mm)**. All HU values follow the standard Hounsfield scale.

post.description: Accepts one or more DICOM files (multipart/form-data). Returns a session_id and the metadata of every series found.

get.description: Returns the automatically computed lower/upper thresholds for the loaded series, along with the strategy used and a human-readable hint.

post.description: Runs marching-cubes segmentation with the provided thresholds, cleanup and smoothing levels. Returns the mesh URL (.vtp) for vtk.js.

post.summary: Detect aneurysm in the segmented mesh
post.description: Runs the aneurysm detection algorithm on the segmented mesh. Returns the location and an isolated dome mesh URL.

get.description: Returns quantitative morphometry of the detected aneurysm. All linear values are in millimetres. Check neck_valid before trusting AR, BF and DNR.

Returns all perforator vessel candidates found near the aneurysm neck. Each candidate includes its 3D position, radius, distance to the neck and risk classification (1=High/red, 2=Medium/yellow, 3=Low/green).

get.summary: Get longitudinal follow-up data for the current patient
get.description: Returns all historical planning sessions for the same patient, ordered by date, plus computed deltas between the current and the most recent previous session.

post.description: Runs the multi-factor decision engine using aneurysm morphometry (from the current session) and optional clinical inputs. Returns a scored recommendation with individual factor breakdown.

bf.description: Bottleneck Factor = max_diameter / neck_mm  (> 1.5 â wide neck)

compactness.description: Wadell sphericity â 1 = perfect sphere, 0 = highly irregular

ui.description: Undulation Index = 1 â V_sac / V_convex_hull  (> 0.15 â irregular)

nsi.description: Non-Sphericity Index = 1 â Wadell_sphericity  (0 = perfect sphere)
